article.story: BURLINGTON, Vt. -- — Riley Fox's 23 points helped Yale hold off Vermont 77-74 on Sunday. Fox shot 9 for 14 (2 for 4 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line for the Bulldogs (7-1). Isaac Celiscar scored 16 points and grabbed five rebounds. Nick Townsend added 13 points. Gus Yalden led the way for the Catamounts (5-4) with 22 points and seven rebounds. TJ Hurley finished with 19 points and TJ Long scored 18. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
